item.title: Gophers men’s hockey ends seven-game losing streak with win over rival Wisconsin
item.description: For the first time since Dec. 4, the Gophers men’s hockey team won a game. They ended a seven-game losing streak, topping Wisconsin at 3M Arena at Mariucci Friday night, 4-1. It was Wisconsin’s fifth consecutive loss. The Gophers hadn’t had a losing streak this severe since the 1997-1998 season.
